This implies that Risperidone may indirectly influence Cyp3a7 through its interaction with Nefazodone. The lowest common ancestor of Risperidone and Nefazodone is the class of Organonitrogen Heterocyclic Compound, and both are agents affecting the nervous system, suggesting a shared biological pathway. The integration of these pathways highlights a possible role of Cyp3a7 in the metabolism or function of Nefazodone, which in turn may be affected by Risperidone. The evidence is supported by a direct binding event between Nefazodone and Cyp3a7, and the observed causal relationship between Risperidone and Malignant Syndrome Nos, which may be linked to Nefazodone's effect on Cyp3a7. The mechanism is plausible but requires further validation to confirm the exact role of Cyp3a7 in this context.
